name: BTST Daily-Hourly Confluence
description: Seven bullish conditions from BTST SETUP.pdf plus a user-requested bearish mirror. Each side requires all seven conditions. Bearish RSI mirrors bullish RSI around 50; both directions require the same volume spike. MACD 12,26,9 was confirmed by the user. Uses current/forming daily and hourly candles.
bullish: 1 day Close is above 1 day EMA (10)
1 day RSI (14) is greater than or equal to 40 and less than 45, or greater than or equal to 60
1-hour MACD line (12,26,9) is above MACD signal line
1-hour Volume is greater than each of the previous 3 candles
bearish: 1 day Close is below 1 day EMA (10)
1 day RSI (14) is greater than 55 and less than or equal to 60, or less than or equal to 40
1-hour MACD line (12,26,9) is below MACD signal line
1-hour Volume is greater than each of the previous 3 candles
